spindle.console.ResetRefusal.title: ResetRefusal
spindle.console.ResetRefusal.description: A refused reset. `400`: the body is not JSON, the run loads no world, or the world does not validate; nothing changed. `500`: a store could not be emptied or a row could not be written; the components emptied before it stay empty, the rows before it stay written, and the decisions and mint of the last world are kept. Source: `crates/spindle-ingress/src/console.rs:112-138`, `crates/spindle-ingress/src/answer.rs:27-32`, `crates/spindle-host/src/host.rs:864-869,886-889`.
